title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT IS ONLY TOO GLAD TO GET OFF WITH THE LOSS OF HIS SHOES
summary_hover: In Bombay, Fogg prepares to leave for Calcutta immediately, while Passepartout accidentally offends priests in a pagoda and narrowly escapes, losing his shoes.
summary_detail: Upon arriving in Bombay, Phileas Fogg secures his passport and dines at the railway station, intending to depart for Calcutta that evening. Detective Fix tries but fails to get a local arrest warrant. Meanwhile, Passepartout wanders the city and naively enters a sacred pagoda without removing his shoes. He is attacked by priests but escapes to the station just in time, an incident Fix plans to use to detain Fogg.
